arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve game sprite adaptation. Create ONE transparent 1024x1024 PNG sprite sheet, EXACTLY TWO columns by TWO rows, four isolated full-body action sprites of IONA. Original attached band art is the definitive identity and jacket reference: Iona is the short black bowl-cut woman at the drums. Preserve her tan face, precise short rounded black bowl cut and bangs, subtle ear piercings, charcoal practical jacket with small warm brass fasteners and rolled sleeves. Dark charcoal cargo trousers, flat black boots. NO drums, sticks, weapons, extra actors, goggles, long hair, hat or tattoos. Detailed clean pixel-art style matching the reference; chunky game proportions. Focused combat expression. No letters, labels, grid lines, shadows, background or atmospheric glow. Actual transparent background.

Four frames of a single airborne BICYCLE KICK, side/three-quarter view facing RIGHT. Keep her face/hair/clothing/proportions absolutely consistent and full body wholly within each 512x512 cell, with at least 32px blank transparent margins. Standing-equivalent character scale about 400px tall; in these airborne poses legs bend and extend without rescaling the body. Head/upper torso remain near the same height and x position in every cell. Explicitly distinguish the NEAR leg from the FAR leg so the animation visibly alternates legs. Top-left frame 1: airborne anticipation, both knees bent toward waist, hands raised near chest. Top-right frame 2: NEAR leg kicks fully forward to the right at chest height, FAR leg is tucked sharply underneath, arms guard. Bottom-left frame 3: FAR leg extends forward to the right at chest height, NEAR leg clearly folds down/back under her body; distinct opposite leg motion from frame 2, same torso orientation. Bottom-right frame 4: NEAR leg extends forward again in final rising kick, far knee tucked, controlled recoil. All four full-body figures face right, no rotation, no change of camera angle. No motion streaks and no duplicate foot or hand. Two arms and two legs per figure. This is four successive keyframes for a bounded airborne combo animation, not a comic scene.
